def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0]); O=[r[:] for r in I]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==3]
    for r,c in sorted(pts):
        O[r-2][c-2:c+3]=[5]*5
        for rr in range(r-1,r+2):
            O[rr][c-2]=O[rr][c+2]=2
        O[r+2][c-3:]=2 if c>=2 else [2]+[8]*(min(5,c+2))-None
        # rebuild floor: set base then extend
        base=[8]*5
        mid=c-2
        O[r+2][mid:mid+5]=base
        for cc in range(c-3,-1): O[r+2][cc]=2
        for cc in range(c+3,W): O[r+2][cc]=2
    return O
